name: Motorsports Calendar Widget
author: QBased

sections.description:
Motorsports Calendar Widget allows you to easily add countdown timers for various motorsport series to your WordPress website. Support for Formula 1, MotoGP, WEC, NASCAR, and many more racing series.

Features:
* Support for multiple racing series
* Customizable themes (light/dark)
* Weather information display
* Compact and full display modes
* Color customization options
* Responsive design
* Easy to use widget interface
* Shortcode support for use anywhere in your content

The plugin can be used either as a widget or via shortcode in your posts and pages.

Shortcode Usage:
Basic usage:
[motorsports_calendar]

With parameters:
[motorsports_calendar series=”f1″ theme=”dark” display=”full” color=”#ff0000″ weather_display=”full” weather_bg_color=”rgba(0,0,0,0.1)” weather_text_color=”#ffffff” time_size=”2em” label_size=”1em”]

Available shortcode parameters:
* series: all, f1, f2, f3, f1-academy, indycar, indylights, formula-e, wec, lemans, imsa, nascar-cup, nascar-xs, nascar-truck, nascar-euro, super-formula, supergt, dtm, v8supercars, motogp, moto2, moto3, wsbk, wrc, dakar, aslms, intercontinental-gt-challenge
* theme: light, dark
* display: compact, full
* color: Any hex color code
* weather_display: no, minimal, full
* weather_bg_color: Any hex color code
* weather_text_color: Any hex color code
* time_size: Any valid CSS font size value
* label_size: Any valid CSS font size value

External Services

This plugin utilizes the MotorsportsCalendar.com API service to provide accurate race countdown and weather information. The following data is transmitted to MotorsportsCalendar.com:

  1. Calendar Data Service

– Purpose: To fetch upcoming race schedules and countdown information
– Data Transmitted: Only the selected racing series preference
– Frequency: When the widget loads on a page
– Service Provider: MotorsportsCalendar.com
– Terms of Service: https://motorsportscalendar.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://motorsportscalendar.com/privacy

  1. Weather Information Service (Optional)

– Purpose: To display weather forecasts for race events
– Data Transmitted: Race location coordinates (only when weather display is enabled)
– Frequency: When viewing races with weather display enabled
– Service Provider: Open-Meteo via MotorsportsCalendar.com
– Weather Data Terms: https://open-meteo.com/en/terms
– Weather Data Privacy: https://open-meteo.com/en/privacy

All data transmission is done securely via HTTPS. No personal user data is collected or transmitted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/motorsports-calendar-widget directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the plugin in one of two ways:
    • Go to Appearance > Widgets to add and configure the widget
    • Use the [motorsports_calendar] shortcode in your posts or pages
sections.faq:
Which racing series are supported?

The widget supports Formula 1, Formula 2, Formula 3, MotoGP, WEC, NASCAR, IndyCar, Formula E, and more.

Is the widget responsive?

Yes, the widget automatically adjusts to fit your theme’s widget areas.

Can I use the calendar outside of widget areas?

Yes, you can use the [motorsports_calendar] shortcode to add the calendar anywhere in your posts or pages. See the Description section for full shortcode documentation.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, both the widget and shortcode support customization options including:
* Light and dark themes
* Custom accent colors
* Compact or full display modes
* Weather display options
